name: Droost Examples
description: Modern, green-by-default reference implementations of common Drupal patterns, generated by the Droost scaffolder. A current alternative to Examples for Developers — read the source; not for production.
project_description: Droost Examples is a catalog of modern, green-by-default reference implementations of common Drupal patterns, every file produced by the Droost scaffolder (`drush droost:scaffold`) and passing phpcs (Drupal + DrupalPractice) and PHPStan at max. It is a current-idiom alternative to the Examples for Developers module — read the source, do not run it in production. It ships one worked example of each pattern: an MCP #[Tool] plugin, an autowired service, an event subscriber, a #[Block] plugin, a FormBase form, an OOP #[Hook], a Drush command, queue-worker/action/field-formatter/field-widget/field-type plugins, a content entity type (ExampleWidget) and a config entity type (ExampleProfile) each with interface/list-builder/forms/access handler, a standalone entity access control handler, a route subscriber, a kernel-test skeleton, a Single Directory Component (example_card), and Views field/filter/sort handlers with their views_data. Because it is generated by the scaffolder and indexed by droost_module_docs / droost_search, an AI agent can find a correct, current example before writing code. Admin routes are gated by restrict-access permissions; the module is a local-development reference.
